narrative:
Greene County has 119,653 registered voters, with 53.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 15.3%, a pronounced Republican lean of 15.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.3% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -3.2% D−R vs -26.1% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
